skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Horus' Rest
skins.content: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Horus' Rest. Lazvar understands that even clockwork fowlbeasts occasionally need a break from yellow sands and clamorous crowds, finding a moment's rest on branches.
skins.usage: One of Sand Reckoner's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Time is not a thing you can buy with gems, no matter how many of them you offer. It is for this reason that Sand Reckoner is willing to enjoy this little break.
